text: Peloton priced its IPO on September 25, 2019 at $29 a share and closed its first day at $25.76, below the offer. The stock peaked at $167.42 on January 13, 2021, fell to a low of $2.88 on August 14, 2024, and closed the five years at $4.68 on September 30, 2024, 83.9% below the offer price. Its filings show pandemic demand fading, then repeated forecast cuts, restructuring and leadership changes as sales slowed.
